review_notes: I read all of lines 1–155 and checked the proofs for simp-interface problems. The file declares no @[simp] lemmas, no simp sets, and no simp-normal-form definitions. I did not run Lean, and I did not search Mathlib for simp lemmas that might overlap with these proofs, so my confidence rests on the file's content alone.
